Implementation Plan

Clarification mapping:
- No `Q<ID>` clarification questions were issued in the clarify phase.
- Interpreted `/answer [auto-answered-by-clarify]` as “scope is sufficiently specified; proceed with planning.”

Implementation plan for Item 8 (`.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml`):

1. Files likely to change
- `.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml` only.
- Focus area: `Resolve merge conflicts with Codex` step, specifically the block immediately before the conflict-resolver prompt heredoc and the prompt body itself.

2. Functions/modules to implement
- Add a prompt-context assembly block before `Rules:` in the conflict-resolver heredoc that writes:
- `=== PR INTENT ===`
- `Title: <PR title>`
- `Body: <PR body capped at 200 lines>`
- `Linked issue: <linked issue body capped at 200 lines or none>`
- Reuse `PR_META_FILE` for `title` and `body` first.
- Add minimal linked-issue body fetch only if linked-issue body is not already present in metadata:
- Resolve linked issue number from PR linkage (prefer GraphQL `closingIssuesReferences(first:1)`).
- Fallback to existing issue-number extraction pattern from PR title/body if needed.
- Fetch issue body via REST issue endpoint.
- Keep fail-open behavior: on any failure or unresolved issue, use `none`.
- Keep existing `codex exec --model ... --full-auto "$(cat "${CONFLICT_RESOLVER_PROMPT_FILE}")"` invocation shape unchanged.

3. Data structures affected
- `PR_META_FILE` usage is extended (read existing `title`/`body`, optionally read linked-issue fields if present in future metadata).
- `CONFLICT_RESOLVER_PROMPT_FILE` schema changes by prepending a deterministic “PR intent” section.
- New temporary shell variables for capped text and linked-issue content (no persistent schema migration).

4. API/interface changes
- No external workflow input/output or positional arg changes.
- Internal prompt interface to the conflict resolver changes (more context, same command shape).
- Minimal GitHub API usage added in resolver step when needed:
- GraphQL: `pullRequest(number){ closingIssuesReferences(first:1){ nodes{ number } } }`
- REST: `GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues/{issue_number}` (body field)
- Ensure resolver step has required auth env (`GH_TOKEN`) and repository context.

5. Potential risks and edge cases
- PR body or issue body empty/null: render as empty body section or `none` (for linked issue).
- Multiple linked issues: choose first deterministically; document this in comments.
- API/rate-limit/transient failures: must not fail step; degrade to `none`.
- Very large markdown bodies: enforce 200-line cap to prevent prompt bloat.
- Special characters/newlines in body text: preserve safely in heredoc output.
- Preserve existing resolver constraints and no-network rule text while adding intent block.

6. Testing considerations
- Workflow syntax validation after edit.
- Dry-run check of generated `CONFLICT_RESOLVER_PROMPT_FILE` content in CI logs/artifacts for:
- intent block always present,
- body capped to 200 lines,
- linked issue shown as capped body or `none`.
- Conflict-path integration check on a synthetic conflicted PR:
- verify resolver still runs,
- verify no positional-argument changes to `codex exec`,
- verify fail-open when linked issue cannot be resolved.
- Regression check: non-conflict runs and downstream labeling/merge logic remain unchanged.

Codebase conflict detection:
- No naming/path mismatch with the issue request.
- Noted gap (expected): current `PR_META_FILE` contains PR title/body but no linked issue body, so minimal GH fetch is required to satisfy the new `Linked issue:` prompt field.
